propositions: A single effective link_map must govern both ADD (_diff_links) and REMOVE (_diff_link_removals) mutations via a shared _resolve_link resolver that composes config override link-type with built-in swap.
Skip overrides must be symmetric: a relation mapped to 'skip' suppresses both ADD emission and REMOVE emission — never added, never removed, never approximated.
REMOVE attribution must recover relation from remapped (overridden) vendor types via an inverted link_map to avoid spuriously dropping or adopting config-remapped remote links.
Undeclared link types must fail closed via validate() raising MappingConfigError when a link_map value falls outside declared link_types vocabulary.
Both jira/backend.py and jira_datacenter/backend.py consumers must route through the single config-driven effective_link_map seam; no [mapping] block leaves behavior unchanged.
